title: Runtime Generation Immutability
summary: A RuntimeGeneration is an immutable code closure; once activated, its code and dependencies cannot be silently changed for in-flight requests.
why: Prevents non-deterministic behavior where a request's logic changes midway through execution due to a global upgrade.
invariants: Code upgrades and client-configuration upgrades are separate atomic operations.
Neither is allowed to silently change an in-flight request.
A request is pinned to its AbilityGeneration for its entire lifetime.
